name: Quotewise Daily
tagline: A quotation desk that can prove who actually said it
description: Serves one chosen quotation a day that stays put until tomorrow, and searches the rest by idea rather than exact wording, so you can find a line you only half remember. Every result carries a link back to where it came from, and it will test a shaky attribution before you repeat it.
author: quotewiser
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
